narrative.northStar: A glance, then back to work
narrative.overview: A black notch attached to the top edge expands into media, focus and system controls. The desktop remains the surrounding interface.
keyCharacteristics: One expanded context at a time

rules.name: The visible shape owns input
rules.body: Pixels outside the notch pass through to the desktop.

rules.name: Hover to peek
rules.body: The user prefers the original 288 by 40 logical pixel compact size and hover expansion enabled by default. Only the explicit top Pin button keeps the island open; other clicks and navigation do not pin. Keep the visible settings button and monitor movement fixes.

dos: Keep opt-in task, microphone and notification states explicit; never force-expand for transient events
